svg.title: To make the path prices explicit, let rμ be the common path analyticity radius at width μ/2, and set Jn = Cn([1+2n/rμ]n, Cf). If sG is the color-slot coefficient and cG the real color projection, the row and atom prices are Rn = Jn|sG|∥cG∥eμ and An,k = Jn|sG|keμ. These are the convergent weighted path bounds obtained by spending half the exponential length width. Choose Z′ > 0 bounding all derivatives through order n of w 7→∥w∥2/2 on ∥w∥≤CRn; any number exceeding 1 + CRn + (CRn)2/2 suffices. Put Nn = Pn i=0 |OrderedFinpartition(i)|.
